capabilities: insert callouts through a filterable type-selection dialog command
autocomplete callout syntax when typing [! in a quote block
remove a callout heading and strip one level of quote markers
list the current note's callouts in a sidebar and jump to them
configure the callout type list, including custom types
extras: Installation is manual only: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css must be copied into .obsidian/plugins/insert-callout/; Obsidian 1.13.0 or later is required. Docs are also provided in Japanese. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: restores the 13 built-in Obsidian types (note, abstract, info, todo, tip, success, question, warning, failure, danger, bug, example, quote)
problem: Obsidian renders callouts but has no quick way to insert them, strip them back to plain quoted text, or jump between the callouts in a note.
summary: Callout helper that inserts callouts via a type-selection dialog or autocomplete, removes them together with quote markers, and lists a note's callouts in a sidebar.
